user.title: Connect the TV
user.description: Enter a name, the TV address and the QuietThings API token. The TV MAC address and the Wake-on-LAN broadcast address are detected automatically.

mac.title: TV MAC address
mac.description: The MAC address of the TV could not be detected. Enter it (for example aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff); it is used to wake the TV.

pair.title: Pair with the TV
pair.description: Select Submit, then choose Allow on the TV within 60 seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: QuietThings API token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current QuietThings API token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV or the QuietThings API.
error.invalid_auth: The QuietThings API token was rejected.
error.unsupported_api: The TV reports QuietThings API version {version}; this integration needs {supported}.
error.name_required: Enter a name for the TV.
error.invalid_broadcast: Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.
error.pairing_failed: The TV did not confirm pairing. Try again and choose Allow.

error.invalid_broadcast: Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.
